findings.desc: quality-cleanup: dirty-gate-policy.ts:145 defines `const PASSING_CATEGORY_NAMES` but never references it anywhere in the file or codebase. Dead constant — should be removed or used.

quality-cleanup: story-advance.ts:447 always appends the advisory message "如果这些文件来自 koala validate / npm test" to the hint even when result.allPass=true. When all dirty paths are policy-allowed passing categories, this message is contradictory: the hint already says audit lines were appended, but then advises the user to make validation side-effect free — implying they did something wrong. Should be conditional on !result.allPass.

CHK-004:edge:0 evidence mismatch: intent specifies "worktree has only runtime_artifact_changes → evaluateDirtyGate allPass=true with 1 audit line" (B-3506 auto-commit scenario), but verificationEvidence note points to section (5) which tests solo declared_artifact_changes (BL21 path). The runtime_artifact_changes solo scenario is only covered in the 3-category mix of section (3), not as a standalone case. Evidence note is misleading and the specific intent (sole runtime_artifact) is not directly tested.

packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts:94 uses dirtyWorktreeClassifierOptionsFromConfig(config) even when storyId is supplied, so validate-side-effect does not load per-story declared-artifacts.json. Repro: executeValidationPlan(..., storyId) writing a declared BL21 artifact returns fail with unexpected_dirty_files=1 instead of policy-allowed declared_artifact_changes, contradicting CHK-002 validate-side-effect and CHK-004 declared artifact semantics.
